It had high health, high speed, and defense, meaning that heavy damage was required to eliminate this enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Knight''' had green skin and wore white and grey full body armor. It wielded a mace and a purple and orange colored shield. While running, it held up a shield in front of it with its left arm. ==Strategy== *Cheap towers with high DPS are recommended, like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Scout|{{Color|Golden}} Scout]] or the [[Ace Pilot]]. *Towers that deal full damage to defense enemies, like the [[Mortar]] or the [[Military Base]] can be useful against this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Executioner - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Knight''' on a promotional video.
